## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint` (from `frontend/`)
- [ ] `npm run build` (from `frontend/`)
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` (from `backend/`)
- [ ] Manual checks described below, if applicable

Details:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Existing features and API contracts are preserved, or intentional changes are explained.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for behavior or configuration changes.
- [ ] No secrets, private incident data, or generated local files are included.
- [ ] Any screenshots are real captures and have been reviewed for sensitive information.
- [ ] Known limitations and follow-up work are documented.
